title: FBI Photo B17
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The source PDF page contains no readable text — all factual claims derive from the CSV metadata description and narrative description, not from text within the document itself.

No mission report accompanied the image, so operational context is absent.
The date shown in the image is acknowledged to be incorrect, making precise dating impossible from the image alone.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data or witness accounts provided.
